newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese bonds end off lows, await Greenspan.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese bonds end off lows, await Greenspan.

text.p: 1635 GMT - Portuguese bonds ended off the lows in light liquidity as the market turned its attention to tomorrow's speech by Fed chairman Alan Greenspan and an auction of five-year Portuguese bonds.
*Spread vs 10-yr cash Bund 68 bps vs 69 bps
Portuguese cash bonds and futures closed off the lows in line with elsewhere in Europe after a session marked by low liquidity and profit taking, dealers said.
"The trend continues to be downward, due to profit taking, but pressure is light as the market awaits tomorrow's speech by (Fed chairman Alan) Greenspan," an operator said.
Operators' attention also focused on tomorrow's five-year Portuguese bond auction.
The yield spread between two- and 10-year bonds closed at 104 basis points, compared with 105 at the close on Friday.
